primary_analysis: Confirmatory paired McNemar-style analysis executed by paired_binary_analysis_v1 on the preregistered N=300 matched pairs (paired_binary_episode_v1). Two-sided alpha=0.05. Primary missingness/failure treatment: complete_pair_primary. Compute 95% bootstrap CI for the paired risk-difference with 1,000 resamples (bootstrap applied to paired differences). Report exact McNemar p-value.
secondary_analyses: median_model_call_overhead_per_intent (GVR_calls − baseline_calls) — exploratory; report median, IQR, 95% CI
availability_regression_rate_difference (proportion of configs causing loss of previously-allowed reachability) — exploratory; report absolute difference and 95% CI
verifier_disagreement_rate (proportion of intent-method cases where Batfish and static analyzer disagree) — exploratory; report rate and 95% CI
sensitivity_analyses: include_high_overlap_items_sensitivity (include intents flagged for high public-corpus overlap to assess contamination influence)
uncertainty_quantification: Primary: 95% bootstrap confidence interval with 1,000 resamples for paired risk-difference; report McNemar exact p-value (alpha=0.05). Secondary: 95% bootstrap CIs (1,000 resamples) or appropriate nonparametric CIs for medians; report standard errors where applicable.
multiplicity_implementation: Single confirmatory primary test at alpha=0.05. Two prespecified subgroup tests (benign, adversarial) adjusted using Holm correction across the two tests. Secondary estimands are exploratory (no confirmatory alpha allocation).
contamination_analysis: Automated duplicate/overlap handling per preregistration: exact duplicates removed prior to execution; fuzzy duplicates with normalized edit distance <0.15 excluded; items flagged as high public-corpus overlap are retained but marked and evaluated in sensitivity analyses. All flags and deterministic checks are recorded in the task_manifest_path and execution manifest.
table_specifications: Table 1: Primary paired outcome summary — counts of concordant/discordant pairs, paired risk-difference (guarded − baseline), McNemar p-value, 95% bootstrap CI (1,000 resamples).
Table 2: Subgroup results — benign and adversarial paired risk-differences, Holm-corrected p-values, 95% CIs.
Table 3: Secondary estimands — median_model_call_overhead_per_intent (median, IQR, 95% CI), availability_regression_rate_difference (rate, 95% CI), verifier_disagreement_rate (rate, 95% CI).

Table 4: Failure and call-count summary — distribution of model_call_count_per_intent, counts by failure_category (model_api_failure, emulator_failure, verifier_failure), completed vs failed episode counts.
Table 5: Verification concordance table — Batfish vs static analyzer outcome cross-tabulation and disagreement counts (verifier_disagreement_rate).
Table 6: Representative per-intent evidence links — intent_id, benign/adversarial flag, outcome per arm, artifact hashes (linking to raw_results.jsonl)
